mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before window seat installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before window seat installation, consider clearing the area around the window to provide our team with unobstructed access. Think about your desired functionality, such as whether you need storage, a deep lounging space, or a simple decorative bench, and gather any inspiration photos you may have. Disclosing any existing structural issues around the window or previous modifications can also help us plan effectively and ensure a smooth process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the installation area, decide on desired functionality and storage needs, and provide inspiration photos before installation.
